title: Sindhu Wins Japan Open Title, Ends Drought Against Yamaguchi
indian_angle: PV Sindhu's victory at the Japan Open marks a significant return to form and a major title for India.
summary: PV Sindhu clinched her maiden Japan Open title by defeating home favourite Akane Yamaguchi, ending a long title drought and silencing doubters with a dominant performance.

title: Sindhu, Shetty Exit China Open Super 1000 After Wasting Match Points
indian_angle: India's top shuttlers PV Sindhu and young talent Ayush Shetty faced disappointing exits from a Super 1000 event after failing to convert match points.
summary: PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty both suffered defeats at the China Open Super 1000, losing crucial matches despite holding match points, leading to their early elimination from the tournament.

title: Ayush Shetty Triumphs Over Alwi Farhan at China Open
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty secured a notable victory against promising Malaysian junior star Alwi Farhan at the China Open, showcasing his potential on the international stage.
summary: Rising Indian talent Ayush Shetty delivered a strong performance at the China Open, defeating promising Malaysian player Alwi Farhan in a match highlighted as a clash of future badminton stars.

title: Kidambi Srikanth Finishes Runner-Up at US Open
indian_angle: Kidambi Srikanth reached the final of the US Open, demonstrating his competitive spirit on the international circuit, though he couldn't clinch the title.
summary: Indian shuttler Kidambi Srikanth's impressive run at the US Open came to an end in the final, where he was defeated by Su Li Yang, finishing as the runner-up in the tournament.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for junior domestic tournaments, impacting young Indian players' development and match strategy.
summary: BAI announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, aiming to bring new dynamics to junior matches.

title: BAI Releases Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has issued crucial guidelines for player eligibility for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships, shaping the future of Indian badminton talent.
summary: BAI has released the eligibility criteria for Indian players aspiring to participate in the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, outlining the requirements for selection.
